steps.title: define information architecture and main flows
steps.work: design course home, import inbox, reading, study, presentation practice, requirements, progress, and settings. Map first use, returning use, interruption recovery, offline use, and error recovery. Use the supplied COMM 110 content to ground examples.
steps.deliverables: screen map, user-flow specifications, content hierarchy.

steps.title: establish the visual and accessible interaction system
steps.work: specify typography, spacing, color/contrast, responsive layouts, density settings, focus states, reduced motion, keyboard behavior, and narration controls. Design default 2D components and clear boundaries for embedded 3D.
steps.deliverables: design tokens, component/state inventory, accessibility specification.
steps.source_checks: contrast calculations, type/line-length review, keyboard/focus specifications, touch target review, narrow-window layouts, and no motion-dependent information. Checkpoint.

steps.title: produce high-fidelity review artifacts
steps.work: create linked screens or dependency-free prototypes for importing a screenshot, correcting an extraction, studying a passage, attempting PQP practice, and resuming work. Include empty, loading, error, offline, and success states. Use actual source-derived content privately and safe fixtures in public history.
steps.deliverables: reviewable design prototype and annotated interaction specs, including selected 3D storyboard only where instructional value exists.
steps.source_checks: all intended prototype controls work or are visibly identified as simulated; source labels readable; state coverage complete; no mock provider behavior represented as working integration. Checkpoint.
amendments: AUTH-1-2: prepare design proposals and image prompts, then wait for external image generation. Keep 2.3 incomplete until images are returned and reviewable artifacts satisfy every required check.
